title: Unit economics actual ledger in docs/rbpc/FINANCIAL_ASSUMPTIONS.md and backend/routers/

implementation_summary.goal: Unit economics actual ledger with strict separation between cash actuals and GMV forecasts, cost structure inference (server hosting, AI tokens, take rate), and school B2B separated from visitor cultural commerce.

cash_actuals_vs_gmv_forecasts.cash_actuals: Derived strictly from rbpc_settlement_ledger where status IN ('approved', 'settled'). Tracks realized gross, collected cash platform fees, remitted taxes, and net artisan payouts.
cash_actuals_vs_gmv_forecasts.gmv_forecasts: Tallies unsettled pipeline inquiries and bottom-up SOM Year 1 targets (570M VND GMV, 57M VND Net Revenue). Strictly tagged with truth_tier='FORECAST' and epistemic notices.

cost_structure_inference.server_hosting: BNIX corporate in-kind compute sponsorship (Dedicated Cloud VPS, 4 vCPU, 8GB RAM, 100GB NVMe, 1,142,400 VND/yr). Shadow commercial replacement rate: 95,200 VND/month.
cost_structure_inference.ai_tokens: Phổ Tuệ corporate in-kind AI compute credits ($7,610 USD / 201,218,238 VND). Commercial replacement rate: ~270 VND per inquiry (6 questions @ 1,500 context tokens with Gemini 3.8 Flash Tiered).
cost_structure_inference.take_rate: 10.0% standard performance commission (15.0% maximum ceiling; 0 VND fixed overhead).

dual_margins.sponsored_runway: 100.0% cash contribution margin under subsidized infrastructure.
dual_margins.commercial_shadow: Deducts commercial replacement server and AI token costs to measure baseline self-sufficiency (break-even at 3 bookings/month across Huế).

revenue_stream_separation.visitor_commerce: Consumer FIT and cultural traveler bookings for participatory workshops (Phường Đúc, Pháp Lam, Thanh Tiên; blended 516,667 VND).
revenue_stream_separation.school_b2b: Institutional secondary school heritage cohorts, curriculum modules, and accredited micro-credentials (average ~5,000,000 VND).

negative_abuse_invariant.rule: Partner inquiry creates 0 VND revenue without verified payment or settled transaction.
negative_abuse_invariant.enforcement: Inquiries in any status ('new', 'contacted', 'confirmed', 'completed') contribute exactly 0.0 VND cash revenue and 0.0 VND realized GMV. Verified and exposed via negative_abuse block.

endpoints.description: Aggregate verified unit economics actual ledger report with cash actuals, cost inferences, stream segmentation, and negative abuse audit block.
Create verified settlement record supporting optional revenue_stream parameter ('visitor_commerce' or 'school_b2b').

verification_results.migration_safety: PASSED (Single head verified, additive only, 0 destructive ops)
